seed_ledger.name: Blue Valley Power Plant (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Independence Power Partners is rebuilding the retired Blue Valley plant to power the Nebius campus (250 MW by Oct 2027, 1.1 GW by Dec 2029). Sources checked: city and local news (KSHB, KCTV5, DCD, AOL) show the plant and campus but name no gas supplier or lateral; a 2024 DCD story names UET Ventures as an early lease partner only; FERC and Federal Register searches show Southern Star prior notices elsewhere in Missouri but none for Independence; Southern Star's Tri-State Energy Corridor open season does not name the plant; Missouri PSC and air permit searches surfaced nothing for this site; EIA workbook not tied. Searches run: 11.

evidence.note: city and plant plan for Nebius campus, no gas supply named
250 MW Oct 2027 and 1.1 GW Dec 2029 plant plan, no pipeline

seed_ledger.name: Cedar River Generating Station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: Dropped: 94 MW, five Wartsila engines at the Prairie Creek site, approved by the Iowa Utilities Commission, online mid 2027. Alliant says it balances wind and solar and replaces coal; no source ties it to a data center. Iowa DNR draft air permit 25-079 lists the engines and only small heater boilers, no gas lateral. No dedicated pipe found. Searches run: 8.

evidence.note: plant purpose and timing, no data center or pipeline

seed_ledger.name: Genesee County power station (gas supply)
seed_ledger.reason: NOT_FOUND: Consumers plans a 900 MW to 1,000 MW gas plant at its Thetford Township site, in service 2031, in its 2026 long-range plan. Crain's reports Consumers is near final terms with a hyperscale data center, but the CEO says the capacity is not contingent on data centers and no source ties Thetford to one. Site is described only as having access to high-volume gas delivery. No new lateral found in Crain's, CBS, DCD, Bridge, ELPC or older 2013 air permit coverage; no 2026 EGLE or MPSC docket surfaced. Searches run: 8.

evidence.note: earlier Thetford plant, site has high-volume gas access
Consumers 1 GW hyperscale deal, site not named
